name: satisfit
description: Review your SatisFIT workouts and progress, log workouts, and create training plans, goals and body measurements in your SatisFIT account.

interface.longDescription:
SatisFIT is a workout tracker for strength training. Connect your SatisFIT account to work with your training data in conversation.

- Review your history: see the workouts you logged on any day or over a date range, with every exercise and set.
- Understand your progress: personal bests, estimated rep maxes, total weight lifted, workout streaks, and how consistently you follow your training plan.
- Log workouts by describing them: say what you did and the session is saved, with each exercise matched to the SatisFIT exercise library.
- Build training plans: describe your goal, schedule and equipment, and the plan is saved to your account, ready to follow in the SatisFIT app.
- Track body measurements and goals: add measurements such as body weight, and set goals for an exercise or a measurement.

Everything you create appears in the SatisFIT app on iOS, Android and the web. The connection reaches only your own SatisFIT account, and when you sign in you choose whether changes are allowed or your data is only read.
defaultPrompt: Show my workouts from the last 2 weeks and summarize my progress.
